senses.gloss:
(इ) लिगि r. 1st cl. (लिङ्गति)
To go, to move.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (लिङ्गति लिङ्गयति)
To paint, to variegate.
With आङ् prefixed,
To embrace.

n. (-गु)
1 The heart, the mind.
m. (-गुः)
1 A fool, a blockhead.
2 A deer.
3 Part of the earth.
E.
लग to be near or with, Uṇādi aff. कु, and इ substituted for the radical vowel.
